item.description:
Thimble 0.9.3 makes Android feel more at home, and the list colors easier to see.
- Android: turning the phone, changing the text size, or Android closing Thimble in the background no longer sends you back to the start. What you had open, and a task you were typing, stay. - Android: on a tablet, an open foldable, or a phone on its side, your lists sit beside what's open. - Android: screens slide in and out, and the Back gesture shows where it will take you before you let go. - Android: the drag handle and a doc's checklist are easier to tap, and TalkBack can jump between a list's sections. - Today, Upcoming, Anytime, and Someday have deeper colors in light mode, so their icons stand out on white, on the Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Android.
